acceptanceCriteria: darwin samples CPU utilisation from host_processor_info deltas between ticks (no extra command) and pressure uses it in place of, or alongside, load average as specified.
The config can select which signals participate per OS (e.g. memory only on darwin).
Tests cover the delta computation, first-tick behaviour and signal selection; non-darwin behaviour is unchanged.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

GitHub beamfall/corvint#646 (macOS, 10 CPUs, Colima 8 vCPU): dispatch status level 2 reason load, loadPerCpu 3.185, memory level 1, while the host had CPU headroom; VM vCPU threads and audit-blocked writers inflate vm.loadavg. #636 left out a CPU-utilisation signal.

Evidence (each digest is that file's sha256 at the merge commit): sealed CEM .corvint/changes/4497acbdc2443a7558337ed650bcea433fc9ae64.cem.json; docs/decisions/0439-rc3-batch-4-requirements-accepted-2026-10-07.md (owner acceptance of the batch 4 requirements); docs/build-log/2026-10-06-dispatch-cpu-signal-config-reload.md. Manual route because native completion is refused for a reason unrelated to evidence: on V1-0904, claim, submit (tree 6b9f2b71) and gate run focused-docs in a clean worktree at the merge commit all succeeded, but complete --commit 8c02f255 refused STALE_TREE with warning 'commit 8c02f2552421b718b9d9b94d75f6d0afc1a11984 is not reachable from main'. Local main in the primary checkout is cd70ba0a and holds 2,651 uncommitted paths that may not be touched, so it cannot be fast-forwarded; that attempt was released with reason STALE_TREE. NOT_RUN: make gate, -race, live fleet qualification where the spec says so; macOS CPU ticks not delivered (decision 0439 limits).

title: dispatch pressure on macOS holds level 2 from inflated load average despite CPU headroom (GitHub #646)
